complete_examples.text: The general spectrum structure of the upper -lower bound-aries and suggestion spectrum, were established by adopting a new four -parameter fitting formula.

A modi-fied periodogram method was applied to analyze the measured track irregularity data of the railway and a unified PSD fitting formula that can characterize the basic irregularity characteristics of the railway was proposed to obtain the characteristic parameters of average PSD of the railway.
